get_meeting_summary.name: get_meeting_summary

parameters.description: The recording's ID, as returned by List meetings.
parameters.name: recording_id

recording_id.description: The recording the summary belongs to

template_name.description: Summary template Fathom used, for example 'general'

get_meeting_transcript.description: Fetch the full transcript of a recorded Fathom meeting.
get_meeting_transcript.display_str_template: Get the Fathom transcript for recording '{0}'.
get_meeting_transcript.name: get_meeting_transcript

parameters.description: The recording's ID, as returned by List meetings.
parameters.name: recording_id

recording_id.description: The recording the transcript belongs to

timestamp.description: Offset from the start of the recording, as HH:MM:SS

list_meetings.description: List meetings recorded by Fathom, optionally filtered by date or meeting type.
list_meetings.name: list_meetings

parameters.description: Optional. Only include meetings recorded on or after this time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Optional. Only include meetings recorded on or before this time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Optional. Only include meetings of this Fathom meeting type, by name.
parameters.name: meeting_type

parameters.description: Optional. Pass the 'next_cursor' from a previous run to fetch the next page of meetings.
parameters.name: cursor

meetings.description: Meetings on this page, newest first

invitee_emails.description: Email addresses of everyone on the calendar invite

recorded_by_email.description: Email of the person who recorded the meeting

recorded_by_name.description: Name of the person who recorded the meeting

recording_id.description: Recording ID. Use with Get transcript and Get summary.

scheduled_end_time.description: When the meeting was scheduled to end

scheduled_start_time.description: When the meeting was scheduled to start

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or empty when there are no more meetings

description: Pull your Fathom meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries into workflows.
